images.name: cover
images.title: An *AI Sales Rep* answers every lead
images.sub: Lead response, qualifying, follow-up and booking meetings: what it owns, what it hands to a person, and what the job costs.

images.name: duties
images.title: The sales job, *duty by duty*
rows: Answers forms, emails, ad leads, chats and voicemails within minutes, at any hour, with a question back and times to talk.
Asks the questions the business cares about, records the answers in the CRM and scores the lead against written rules.
Works a written sequence for weeks and picks up the conversation when the lead replies.
Offers times from the salesperson's calendar, sends the invite with a short brief and reschedules cancellations.
Logs every message, outcome and stage change, and fills in missing fields from the conversation.
With consent, checks in with leads that went quiet and passes anyone interested to the salesperson.

images.name: day-on-shift
images.title: A day at an *IT services company*
rows: Replies to 4 overnight form fills. Two answer its questions before 8 am.
A dental clinic with 12 staff qualifies. Books a call with the sales manager for Thursday.
Sends day-five follow-ups to 9 leads from last week, each with a relevant case study.
A law office asks for 15% off a three-year contract. Drafted and held.
A lead cancels tomorrow's call. It offers three new times and rebooks for Monday.
A company with six offices asks for a quote. Brief sent to the manager.
Logs every conversation in the CRM and updates each lead's stage.

images.name: setup
images.title: Setting up an *AI Sales Rep*
steps: Pull the last 50 lost leads and note where each one went quiet.
Who counts as a good lead, the questions to ask, the follow-up sequence and what always goes to a person.
Inbox, web forms, CRM and calendar, with only the access the job needs.
It writes every message and a person approves it. Each edit teaches it tone and limits.
Hand over one step at a time
First replies first, then follow-ups, then anything that touches price.
Someone reads the log and updates the playbook when prices or services change.
